title: MJ12 memos reference CIC involvement at Roswell

tellings.quote: Leaked MJ12 memos from the 1940s reference CIC involvement in UFO investigations, including Roswell.

plain: Leaked papers known as the MJ-12 documents, said to come from a secret 1940s group that handled crashed flying saucers, refer to the Army's Counter Intelligence Corps taking part in UFO investigations, including at Roswell, the reported 1947 crash near Roswell, New Mexico. Jesse Michels tells this himself, citing the MJ-12 memos, on an episode asking whether Henry Kissinger oversaw a program to recover crashed craft.
